decision.justification: Selected 'median' (a seeded deterministic baseline) as the best of 22 backtested attempts, score -0.3459. Series context: trend strength 0.9546 and seasonal strength 0.0986; model ranking is moderate across windows (Kendall tau 0.446); 6 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 123.562.
